slides.title: RDK Course [gradient]Overview[/gradient]
slides.lead: A step-by-step path from your first RDK board to model deployment, TROS development, system debugging, and embodied AI applications.

slides.title: What this course solves
slides.lead: Get started, reproduce experiments, and build toward real projects.

slides.title: Who this course is for
slides.lead: Start from the path that matches your experience with RDK, Linux, AI, ROS, or robotics.

slides.title: Every lesson has four pieces
slides.lead: Videos explain the path, handbooks preserve details, demos support reproduction, and official docs provide complete references.

slides.title: How to learn
slides.lead: Treat every lesson as a small on-device experiment instead of only watching or copying commands.

slides.title: Beginner: RDK Basics
slides.lead: Start with visible results, then cover system flashing, boot troubleshooting, remote access, and peripheral validation.

slides.title: Advanced: from samples to applications
slides.lead: Continue from established basics to models, robotics software, and lower-level system capabilities.

slides.title: Large models and embodied AI
slides.lead: Understand RDK's role in embodied AI by combining speech, vision, ROS/TROS, and large-model capabilities in basic projects.

slides.title: Developer cases: from course to projects
slides.lead: Collect real projects, community work, and representative application solutions for practical reference.

slides.title: Up next: [gradient]Lesson 01[/gradient]
slides.lead: Build an RDK community and ecosystem resource map—where to find documentation, demos, source code, and support.
